answer: Audits are entered in river, queued in cedar, and falcon publishes the wait time. A farm of 36 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 25 identities per epoch. A farm of 1397 identities would post 3781 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
